e.title: Practical Ratemaking (kasaai)
e.summary: 实用费率厘定教程（kasaai，37★）：Practical Ratemaking——非寿险定价的经典教学资源
e.summary_en: Practical Ratemaking tutorial (kasaai, 37★): classical teaching resource for non-life pricing
e.summary_hk: 實用費率釐定教程（kasaai，37★）：Practical Ratemaking——非壽險定價的經典教學資源
e.body: pc-pricing-tutorial（kasaai，37★）是 Practical Ratemaking（实用费率厘定）教程：非寿险定价的经典教学材料——单因素分析到 GLM 定价的完整路径。对 RIAA：定价教学资源——[[insurance-pricing-course]]（burning-cost 课程）、[[loss-data-analytics]]（LDA 教材）之外的经典定价教程；kasaai（加拿大精算研究组，与 Wüthrich 合作）出品；费率厘定实务（分类/经验费率/费率手册）；与 [[insurancerating]]（GLM 定价工具）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定价概念）配套；适合定价方向自学。
e.body_en: pc-pricing-tutorial (kasaai, 37★) is the Practical Ratemaking tutorial: classical teaching material for non-life insurance pricing — from univariate analysis to GLM pricing. For RIAA: a pricing teaching resource — the classical pricing tutorial alongside [[insurance-pricing-course]] (burning-cost) and [[loss-data-analytics]] (LDA textbook); from kasaai (a Canadian actuarial research group collaborating with Wüthrich); ratemaking practice (classification/experience rating/rate manuals); pairs with [[insurancerating]] (GLM pricing tools) and [[actuarial-pricing]] (pricing concepts); suits pricing self-study.
e.body_hk: pc-pricing-tutorial（kasaai，37★）是 Practical Ratemaking（實用費率釐定）教程：非壽險定價的經典教學材料——單因素分析到 GLM 定價的完整路徑。對 RIAA：定價教學資源——[[insurance-pricing-course]]（burning-cost 課程）、[[loss-data-analytics]]（LDA 教材）之外的經典定價教程；kasaai（加拿大精算研究組，與 Wüthrich 合作）出品；費率釐定實務（分類/經驗費率/費率手冊）；與 [[insurancerating]]（GLM 定價工具）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（定價概念）配套；適合定價方向自學。
